# 02 — Dimension reduction

Reads `data/embeddings/song_features.csv`, joins with per-snapshot ranks, and
produces:

- PCA scree plot + biplot (PC1 vs PC2, coloured by release year)
- UMAP 2D embedding of all unique songs, animated by year
- Variance explained by year as a time series (drift signal)

```{r paths}
ROOT    <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input()), "..", ".."), mustWork = FALSE)
FEA_FN  <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "embeddings", "song_features.csv")
META_FN <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "embeddings", "song_metadata.csv")
```
